name: Lentil Stuffed Peppers
ingredients: 2 large bell peppers, halved and deseeded
1 tsp cumin and ½ tsp smoked paprika
steps: Heat the oil and cook the onion and garlic for 4 minutes. Add the tomato and spices and cook for 3 minutes.
Stir in the lentils, quinoa, half the passata, parsley and seasoning.
Fill the peppers and stand them in a baking dish with the remaining passata around them.
Cover with foil and bake for 30 minutes; uncover and bake for 10 more.
note: Lentils and quinoa together give a complete protein; the filling can be made a day ahead.
